prompt:
Write a first-person account (about 120 words) by the driver for an insurance claim form. Accident: hit while turning left in Sugar Land, Texas. Injury: wrist fracture. No names, no dates. (Internal reference C-1492; do not mention it.) Work these facts into the text naturally, in your own words, without listing them:
- The claimant told the same account in every conversation.
- The driver is named on the policy.
text: I was turning left at an intersection in Sugar Land, Texas, when another vehicle struck the side of my car. I had the green light and was moving slowly through the turn when the impact came from the oncoming lane. My car spun partway around and the airbag deployed. I felt a sharp pain in my left wrist right away, and I was later told the wrist was fractured. I have described the events the same way every time I have spoken about them, to the other driver, to the responding officer, and to the medical staff who treated me. I am the named driver on this policy and I have been driving this vehicle with the owner's permission for the past two years. I am submitting this statement so the claim can be reviewed, and I can provide any further details needed.
